assessments.reasoning: The ordinary file list and grammar directly assign .fs to implementation, .fsi to signature, and .fsx and .fsscript to scripts. The grammar derives a script file from implementation-file and expressly admits additional directives. §19.4 describes separate .ml and .mli compatibility mode and neither this nor interactive fragments contradicts the ordinary-mode wording.
